response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, hands-on polyglot engineer with 15+ years of experience, genuine high-scale systems exposure (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic), and current AI-tooling work. However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered on experimentation systems, telemetry, metrics, and statistical rigor — domains where the resume shows essentially no direct experience. His trajectory is senior/staff-level at small-to-mid-size companies, without evidence of the multi-team platform ownership, cross-org influence, or experimentation/measurement expertise this role requires.
strengths: Strong polyglot engineering fundamentals (TypeScript, D, C/C++, Java) with 15+ years of experience
Real high-scale, low-latency distributed systems experience at ad-tech scale
Current hands-on AI/agentic tooling work (MCP generators), matching the AI-first emphasis
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or metrics/telemetry platform experience
No demonstrated Principal-level scope: cross-team platform ownership or org-wide technical leadership
No evident data-science/statistical analysis background required for experimentation quality and bias detection

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale experience
